interpretation.scope: same fixed questions/prompt/options under two new computation seeds; no independent dataset confirmation
interpretation.selection: historically selected best configurations remain exploratory even if rerun p is significant
interpretation.base_arc: reference0 damping-minus-Loop gain is zero; do not claim reproduced extra gain
interpretation.ci: nominal paired bootstrap 95 percent intervals; each repeat retains its own n, never pooled into 2N
interpretation.engineering: negative gain and numerical differences are reported, not treated as automatic Gate failure
interpretation.historical_p: old full-grid adjusted p values are descriptive side columns; they never replace the new 20/10 Holm families
